DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。相談の前に何かお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything I can help you with before your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家計の相談を予約して来ましたが、職場から急に連絡が入るかもしれません。呼ばれた場合は、途中で相談を切り上げたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約した家計相談を職場の呼出しがあれば途中で切り上げたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an appointment for a household budget consultation, but my workplace may contact me unexpectedly. If they call me in, I would like to end the consultation early.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you would like to end your booked household budget consultation early if your workplace calls you in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分かりました。連絡が来たら、こちらに一声おかけください。今日は何を相談する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. If they contact you, please let me know. What were you planning to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 子どもの学用品に備えるため、年間の支出を整理したいです。資料はこちらですが、全部を見てもらう時間がないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 学用品の年間支出を相談したいが資料全部を見る時間がないかもしれないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to organize our annual expenses so we can prepare for the children's school supplies. Here are the documents, but there may not be time for you to look through all of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to discuss annual spending on school supplies, but there may not be time to examine all the documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず資料の項目を確認しましょう。電話が鳴っていますが、対応されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's first check the categories in your documents. Your phone is ringing; would you like to answer it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、職場からです。返事をする間だけ席を外したいです。書類は机の上に置いていますので、戻るまで見えないようにしていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場の電話へ応答する間退席し机の書類を見えないように頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, it's my workplace. I would like to step away just while I answer. I've left the papers on the desk; could you keep them out of sight until I return?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to step away to answer a call from work and have the papers on the desk kept out of sight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料を伏せてお待ちします。戻られた時に、続けるか伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will turn the documents face down and wait. When you return, I will ask whether you would like to continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お待たせしました。すぐ職場へ行くことになったので、今日はここで終わりにしたいです。お預けした資料も全部受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職場へすぐ行くため今日の相談を終了し預けた資料全部を返してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you for waiting. I have to go to work immediately, so I would like to finish here for today. Could I also have back all the documents I gave you?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you must leave for work immediately, end today's consultation, and ask for all the documents you handed over to be returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが資料一式です。支出の項目を見ただけで、年間の計画はまだ検討していません。次回も相談をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the complete set of documents. We only looked at the expense categories and have not yet considered an annual plan. Would you like another consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。受け取った紙は三枚そろっています。次回は学用品を買う時期のメモも持って来たいので、帰ってから相談日時を取り直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却された三枚を確認し購入時期のメモを用意して後で日時を取り直すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. All three sheets have been returned. Next time I would also like to bring notes on when we buy the school supplies, so I will arrange another appointment after I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that all three returned sheets are there, and say you will prepare notes on purchase timing and arrange another appointment later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三枚ともお返しできました。続きは次回のご相談として承ります。お仕事へ向かう際はお気を付けください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have returned all three sheets. We will take up the rest at your next consultation. Please take care on your way to work. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。材料選びでお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help you choose ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分の料理を作りますが、今日と明日の二食に分けたいです。「二人分」だけで選ぶと一食分になりそうで、量の考え方を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人が今日明日の二食分を作り人数だけで量を決めたくないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm cooking for two people, but I want to divide it into two meals, one today and one tomorrow. Choosing just for two people might leave me with only one meal, so I want to check how to calculate the amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about preparing two meals for two people, today and tomorrow, without deciding quantities by the number of people alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二人が二回食べる予定なのですね。同じ料理を二回ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: So two people will be eating on two occasions. Will it be the same dish both times?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。同じ料理です。二人いるから二食という意味ではなく、それぞれ二回食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人各二回同料理で二人だから二食という意味ではないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the same dish. I don't mean two meals simply because there are two of us; each person will eat it twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that both people will eat the same dish twice each, and that two people does not by itself mean two meals. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作り方にある材料量は、何人分の一回ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: How many people and how many meals do the ingredient quantities in the recipe cover?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人分の一回です。そのままの量で二食分だと思っていましたが、必要な回数も考えないといけませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: レシピは二人一回で回数も計算が必要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: They are for one meal for two people. I thought that amount alone would cover two meals, but I also have to consider how many times we will eat it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the recipe is for two people once, and that the number of meals must also be calculated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二人が二回なら、二人分一回のレシピにある材料量の二倍が目安です。袋の数は、その必要量と一袋の内容量で確認できます。残った材料はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: For two people eating twice, use twice the quantities in the recipe for one meal for two as a guide. You can work out the number of packets from the amount needed and the contents of each packet. What will you do with leftover ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋全体を一度に使うつもりはありません。必要な量だけ使い、残りの扱いは商品の表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋全部を使わず必要量のみで残りは表示を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't intend to use a whole packet at once. I'll use only the amount needed and check the product label for how to handle what remains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will not use the entire packet, only the amount needed, and will check the label for the rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日買う袋の数と、料理へ入れる量も別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The number of packets you buy today and the amount you put into the dish are separate matters too, aren't they?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。二人が二回食べる材料量を先に整理してから袋数を選びます。大袋一つなら全部入れるという考え方はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要量と購入袋数を分け大袋全部を料理へ入れないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll first work out the ingredient quantities for two people eating twice, then choose the number of packets. I won't assume that buying one large packet means putting all of it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will distinguish the required quantities from the number of packets bought and will not put an entire large packet into the dish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今回は二人分一回の材料量を二倍にして、二回分を考える形ですね。必要量と商品の内容量を確かめ、残りは表示に沿って扱ってください。量のご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: So this time you will double the ingredient quantities for one meal for two people to cover two meals. Check both the amount needed and the product contents, and handle leftovers according to the label. Thank you for discussing the quantities with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。催しについてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you have a question about the event?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真に写った人を出演者として紹介しようとしましたが、衣装に見える服を着ているだけかもしれません。説明を付ける前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 服装だけで人物を出演者と紹介する前に確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was about to introduce someone in a photo as a performer, but they may only be wearing clothes that look like a costume. I want to check before adding a caption.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check before introducing someone as a performer based only on their clothing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真は舞台で撮ったものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Was the photo taken on stage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、会場の外の通路です。近くを歩く人を撮ったので、出演している場面ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 舞台でなく会場外通路で歩く人の写真と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, it was taken in a passage outside the venue. I photographed someone walking nearby; it does not show them performing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that it is a photo of someone walking in a passage outside the venue, not on stage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それだけでは出演者か判断できません。どんな紹介を予定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That alone doesn't tell us whether they are a performer. What kind of introduction are you planning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人へ催しの様子を話すためです。その人の名前を探して付けるより、写っている場所と時間だけを説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人への催し説明が目的で人物名でなく場所時刻を伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's to tell a friend what the event was like. Rather than finding and adding that person's name, I would like to explain only the location and time shown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the purpose is to tell a friend about the event, and that you want to give the location and time rather than the person's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 人物について確認できないことは付け加えない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is better not to add information about a person that you cannot verify.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。「出演者」とは書かず、通路で撮った写真とします。催しに参加した人だとも断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出演者や参加者と断定せず通路写真と説明すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't write “performer”; I'll say it was a photo taken in a passage. I won't state that the person attended the event either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will describe it as a passage photo without identifying the person as a performer or participant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 公開する場合は、人物の扱いにも配慮してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you make it public, please also be considerate in how you handle images of people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 顔が分かるこの写真は投稿しません。友人への説明には、人が写っていない会場の写真を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 顔付き写真を投稿せず人のない会場写真を説明に使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't post this photo in which the face is recognizable. To explain it to my friend, I'll choose a photo of the venue with no people in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not post the photo showing a recognizable face and will use a venue photo without people for your explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。残りの催しもお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please enjoy the rest of the event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need advice about your train journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅の途中で友人に会うために一度降りたいです。最終目的地は変えずに行けるか、切符の扱いを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 最終目的地を変えず途中下車で友人に会いたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to get off once along the way to meet a friend. I want to check the ticket rules to see whether I can do this without changing my final destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about getting off to meet a friend while keeping the same final destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 降りた後も、同じ目的地へ向かうのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You will still be heading for the same destination after getting off, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。友人と会う駅が旅の終わりではありません。そこまでの切符へ変更してほしい、という希望ではないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会う駅は終点希望でなく切符をそこまでに変更する依頼でないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The station where I meet my friend is not the end of my journey. I am not asking to change my ticket to end there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the meeting station is not your intended final destination and you are not requesting a ticket change to that station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符によって扱いが違います。お持ちの切符を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The rules depend on the ticket. Could you show me yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。以前の旅行では降りられましたが、その経験だけで今回も同じとは考えず確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切符を示し以前できた経験だけで今回を判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. I was able to do this on an earlier trip, but I am checking rather than assuming this trip will work the same way based only on that experience.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your ticket and say you will not judge this trip solely by having been able to do it before. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中で降りたい駅と、その後の移動予定を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell me which station you want to get off at and your travel plans afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの駅で会って、その日のうちに先へ進みたいです。途中で降りることと、同じ列車へ戻ることは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日先へ進む予定で下車と同列車に戻ることは別と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to meet at this station and continue on the same day. Getting off along the way and getting back on the same train are different things, aren't they?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you plan to continue the same day and that getting off is different from returning to the same train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ列車に戻れるとは限りません。切符の条件と後の列車を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may not be able to get back on the same train. I will check your ticket conditions and the later trains.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。降りられるかだけでなく、先へ進む時にどの切符と列車を使うかまで確認してから友人と約束します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 下車条件と後続の切符列車を確認して友人と約束すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Before making arrangements with my friend, I will check not just whether I can get off, but also which ticket and train to use when continuing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will check the stopover conditions and the onward ticket and train before making arrangements with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 途中の駅と、その後も同じ目的地へ向かうご希望を承りました。切符の条件を確認する担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand which intermediate station you mean and that you wish to continue to the same destination afterward. I will direct you to the staff who check ticket conditions. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。地域の説明会についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is this about the local community briefing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日曜の午前中の説明会に出たいのですが、夜勤の後で休む時間と重なります。別の時間に説明を聞く方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤後の休息と日曜午前の説明会が重なるため別の時間に説明を聞けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to attend the Sunday morning briefing, but it overlaps with my rest time after a night shift. Is there a way to hear the explanation at another time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can hear the explanation at another time because the Sunday morning briefing overlaps with rest after a night shift. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この窓口では個別に説明する時間を設けています。平日の午後なら来られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This counter offers individual explanation sessions. Could you come on a weekday afternoon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 木曜の午後なら来られます。配られた紙は持っていますが、ごみを出す場所の図と収集日の表の見方を質問したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 木曜午後なら来られ配布資料のごみ出し場所の図と収集日表の読み方を質問したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can come on Thursday afternoon. I have the handout, but I would like to ask how to read the diagram showing where to put out rubbish and the collection-day table.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you can come on Thursday afternoon and want to ask how to read the handout's rubbish disposal location diagram and collection-day table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 木曜の午後二時に空きがあります。説明に二十分ほどかかりますが、ご都合はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have an opening on Thursday at two in the afternoon. The explanation takes about twenty minutes. Would that suit you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二時でお願いします。二十分なら時間を取れます。紙の図に印を付けて、分からない所を先にまとめてきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 木曜午後二時の二十分の説明を希望し図へ印を付け質問をまとめてくると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two o'clock, please. I can spare twenty minutes. I'll mark the diagram on the handout and organize my questions beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request the twenty-minute explanation at two on Thursday afternoon, and say you will mark the diagram and prepare your questions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 木曜午後二時の個別説明で予約を入れます。ここで分別の説明も聞いてからお帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will book an individual explanation for Thursday at two. Would you also like to hear about waste sorting here before you leave?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は夜勤前なので、予約だけでお願いします。分別についても木曜に聞きたいので、質問のメモへ追加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は夜勤前なので予約だけにし分別の質問も木曜用のメモへ追加すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a night shift today, so please just make the appointment. I'd also like to ask about sorting on Thursday, so I'll add it to my question notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you only want to book today because it is before your night shift, and will add waste sorting to Thursday's question notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。当日は窓口の待合で、個別説明の予約で来たとお伝えください。資料と質問のメモをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. On the day, please go to the counter's waiting area and say you have an appointment for an individual explanation. Bring the handout and your question notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 木曜の午後二時に窓口の待合へ来て、予約のことを伝えます。資料とメモを持参します。別の時間を決められて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 木曜午後二時に待合で予約を伝え資料とメモを持参すると確認して礼を言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll come to the counter's waiting area on Thursday at two and mention my appointment. I'll bring the handout and notes. It helps to have arranged another time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will mention the appointment in the waiting area on Thursday at two, bring the handout and notes, and express thanks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 木曜午後二時の予約を承りました。今日は予約のみで、資料の読み方と分別のご質問は当日の担当が伺います。お気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your appointment is booked for Thursday at two. Today we have only made the booking; the staff member on the day will answer your questions about reading the handout and sorting waste. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどうなさいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What brings you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語で症状を話す練習をしましたが、例文にあった「頭も痛い」をそのまま言いそうになりました。実際は頭痛はなく、肩のことだけ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 練習例の頭痛は実際になく肩のみの相談と訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I practiced explaining symptoms in Japanese, and nearly repeated “I also have a headache” from the example. I don't actually have a headache; I only want to discuss my shoulder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the practice example by explaining that you do not actually have a headache and only want to discuss your shoulder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 練習用の例と、実際の状態を分けたいのですね。肩はいつから気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You want to distinguish the practice example from your actual condition, then. Since when has your shoulder been bothering you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日からです。例文には一週間とありましたが、私の期間は昨日からです。覚えた文章より実際のことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開始は昨日で例文の一週間を自分の期間にしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Since yesterday. The example said one week, but for me it has been since yesterday. I'll explain what is actually happening rather than the sentences I memorized.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that it started yesterday, and that you will not use the example's one-week period as your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自分の言葉で大丈夫です。分からない言葉があれば確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your own words are fine. You can check any words you don't understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 言葉が出なくても、例文の症状を足して長く話すのでなく、分かる範囲を短く伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不明語があっても例症状を足さず実際の範囲を短く伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even if I can't find the words, I'd like to explain briefly what I know, rather than adding symptoms from the example to make my explanation longer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that even if there are words you do not know, you want to describe the actual situation briefly without adding example symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その方が確認しやすいです。準備したメモも使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: That will make it easier to check. Will you also use the notes you prepared?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使います。ただ、練習の例を線で消して、自分の症状と始まった日だけ残したメモを見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 例文を消し自症状と開始日だけのメモを使うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. But I'll cross out the practice example and show notes containing only my own symptoms and the day they started.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will cross out the example and use notes showing only your symptoms and their starting date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診察時に、そのメモと実際の状態をお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: During the examination, please use those notes and describe your actual condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。頭痛はないこと、肩は昨日から気になることを伝えます。メモにない質問は、分からないまま例文で答えず聞き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実症状を説明し準備外質問へ例文で答えず聞き返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll explain that I don't have a headache and that my shoulder has been bothering me since yesterday. If I'm asked something not in my notes, I will ask again instead of answering with an example I don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain your real symptoms and ask for clarification on unprepared questions rather than answering with example sentences. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は頭痛ではなく、昨日から気になる肩についてのご相談ですね。練習例を直したメモをお持ちになり、診察で実際の状態をお伝えください。受付へのお知らせありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Today you are here about your shoulder, which has been bothering you since yesterday, rather than a headache. Please bring your corrected practice notes and tell the doctor your actual condition. Thank you for letting reception know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。道について何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble finding your way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通りがかりの人から駅への近道を聞きました。友人に「警察が案内した」と言いそうになりましたが、まだこちらには確認していません。駅へ歩いて戻れる道か伺いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通行人に聞いた駅への近道を警察の案内と誤って伝えず歩いて駅へ戻れるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A passerby told me a shortcut to the station. I nearly told my friend “the police gave me directions,” but I haven't checked with you yet. I would like to ask whether it is a route I can walk back to the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether you can walk back to the station using a shortcut you heard from a passerby, without wrongly calling it police directions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらが案内した道ではないのですね。どの道ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it isn't a route we gave you. Which road is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この細い道です。通行人は通れると言いましたが、私自身は入口までしか見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 細道入口のみ見て通行可能との話は通行人情報と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This narrow road. The passerby said it was passable, but I have only seen as far as the entrance myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have only seen the entrance to the narrow road, and that the information that it is passable came from a passerby. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 私有地かどうかや、今の通行状況が確認できないので、その近道は案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot verify whether it is private land or the current access conditions, so we cannot recommend that shortcut.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、通れると決めて入らず、確認できる公道の経路を教えてください。少し遠回りでも構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未確認道へ入らず公道経路を遠回りでも頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then, instead of assuming I can enter it, please tell me a route on public roads that you can verify. I don't mind a small detour.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a public-road route, even with a detour, rather than entering an unverified road. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 駅へ戻るなら、正面の広い通りを信号まで進み、そこで右へ曲がって駅の案内表示に沿って歩く経路をご案内できます。同行者はどこで待っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: To return to the station, we can direct you along the wide road ahead to the traffic lights, then right there and along the station signs. Where is your companion waiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駅の前です。友人には最初の近道の話を取り消し、今教わった公道の経路を別に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅前同行者へ近道情報を取消し新公道経路を別に伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: In front of the station. I'll withdraw the first shortcut information and separately tell my friend the public-road route you have just given me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you will retract the shortcut information to your companion in front of the station and give the new public-road route separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 広い通り、信号で右、駅の表示という順です。最初に聞いた細い道へ入る経路とは違うので、ご友人にもその順でお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The order is: wide road, right at the lights, then station signs. That is different from taking the narrow road you first heard about, so please give your friend those steps too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。通行人からの情報と、今回こちらで教わった経路を混ぜず、曲がる場所を友人へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道名曲がり場所を確認し情報源を混ぜず伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll tell my friend where to turn without mixing the passerby's information with the route you have just given me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked the road and turning point, and will convey the directions without mixing the information sources. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 駅へ戻る道は、正面の広い通りを信号まで進んで右へ曲がる順ですね。確認できない近道には入らず、駅の案内表示もご覧ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: The route back is along the wide road ahead to the lights, then right. Please avoid the unverified shortcut and also follow the station signs. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便のことで何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything postal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先生への手紙を出す前に、お礼を一文書き足したくなりました。まだ封はしていません。ペンを少しお借りできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封をする前の恩師への手紙にお礼を一文足したいのでペンを借りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before sending a letter to my teacher, I decided I wanted to add a sentence of thanks. I haven't sealed it yet. Could I borrow a pen briefly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to borrow a pen to add a sentence of thanks to your former teacher's letter before sealing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの黒いペンをお使いいただけます。便箋に書き足せる余白はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use this black pen. Is there room on the writing paper for the addition?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最後に二行ほど空いています。挨拶を全部書き直すのでなく、先生に面接の練習を手伝っていただいたことのお礼を書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二行の余白へ面接練習を手伝ってもらったお礼を書きたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are about two lines left at the end. Rather than rewriting all the greetings, I want to thank my teacher for helping me practice for my interview.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you want to use the two blank lines to thank your teacher for helping with interview practice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その余白へ書くなら、宛名の面と間違えないよう便箋を出してからお使いください。ここで立ったまま書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you write in that space, please take out the writing paper first so you don't confuse it with the address side. Will you write here standing up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カウンターを長く使わないよう、記入台へ移りたいです。便箋と封筒を自分で持ち、窓口には置いていきません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓口を長く使わず便箋と封筒を持って記入台へ移りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to move to the writing desk so I don't occupy the counter for long. I'll carry the writing paper and envelope myself and won't leave them at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to take the writing paper and envelope to the writing desk so you do not occupy the counter for long. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記入台は入口の右側です。書き終わったら、ペンをこちらへ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The writing desk is to the right of the entrance. Please return the pen here when you finish.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。「面接の前に何度も練習に付き合ってくださり、ありがとうございました」と、自分が伝えたいことを一文足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 面接前に何度も練習へ付き合ってもらったお礼を一文足すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll add one sentence expressing what I want to say: “Thank you for practicing with me so many times before the interview.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will add a sentence thanking your teacher for repeatedly helping you practice before the interview. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書く言葉はご自身の気持ちに合わせてお決めください。手紙は書き終わってから封をし、発送の窓口へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please choose words that express your own feelings. Seal the letter after you finish writing and bring it to the mailing counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。記入台で一文を書き、ペンを返してから手紙に封をします。先生へのお礼を入れ終えた後で発送をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一文を書いてペンを返し封をしてから発送を頼むと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll write the sentence at the writing desk, return the pen, and then seal the letter. I'll ask you to mail it after adding my thanks to my teacher.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will write the sentence, return the pen, seal the letter, and then ask for it to be mailed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ペンと記入台の場所をご案内できました。書き足す間は便箋と封筒をお手元で保管してください。準備ができましたら発送を承ります。お声がけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have shown you the pen and writing desk. Please keep the writing paper and envelope with you while adding your message. We will accept it for mailing when you are ready. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご予約についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you enquiring about an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の相談予約が十一時までなので、窓口も十一時で閉まると友人に伝えました。予約の時間と営業時間を混同したかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約終了十一時を窓口閉店と伝え混同の確認をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My consultation appointment ends at eleven, so I told my friend the counter also closes at eleven. I may have confused my appointment time with the opening hours.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether you confused your appointment ending at eleven with the counter closing, as you told your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十一時は、ご自身の相談枠の終了ですね。友人も予約を希望していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Eleven is the end of your own consultation slot, correct? Does your friend also want an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は別の手続きで来たいそうです。私の相談終了時刻を、その手続きの受付終了として伝えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人別手続きへ自予約終了を受付締切と伝えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend wants to come for a different procedure. I mistakenly gave my consultation's finishing time as the closing time for accepting that procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you told your friend, who needs another procedure, that your appointment end time was the application deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手続きによって受付を確認する必要があります。どの手続きか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check reception times for each procedure. Do you know which procedure it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 詳しくは聞いていません。全部同じ時間とまとめず、友人本人に用件を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人用件未詳で一律時刻とせず本人に確認してもらうと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't asked for details. Rather than saying everything has the same hours, I'll have my friend check their own business directly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you do not know your friend's exact purpose, and will ask them to check rather than assuming a single time for everything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それが確実です。あなたの予約は変更しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is the reliable way. Do you want to change your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、私の予約はそのままです。友人の来店案内を直すために、自分の予約を延ばしてほしいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自予約は維持し友人案内訂正のため予約延長希望ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, please keep mine as it is. I am not asking you to extend my appointment to correct the guidance I gave my friend about visiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your appointment should stay as it is, and you are not requesting an extension to correct your friend's visiting information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人から問い合わせていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Your friend can contact us directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。十一時は私の予約終了だと訂正し、友人の用件の受付時間は本人に確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十一時は自予約終了と訂正し友人の受付時間は本人確認を促すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll correct my statement by saying eleven is when my appointment ends, and have my friend check the reception hours for their own procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will clarify that eleven is your appointment end time and encourage your friend to check their own reception hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご予約の時間にお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will see you at your appointment time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご用件を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. May I ask what you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買った食品を家で開けました。好みと違ったので試食のつもりでしたと言いそうになりましたが、購入済みの開封品です。対応できることがあるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入して家で開封した好み違いを試食と呼ばず対応相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I opened some food I had bought at home. Because it wasn't to my taste, I nearly said I had only meant to sample it, but it is a purchased, opened item. I'd like to ask whether anything can be done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about assistance for purchased food opened at home that was not to your taste, without calling it a sample. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店内で試食した物ではないのですね。商品に傷みなどはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it wasn't something you sampled in the shop. Was there any spoilage or anything similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 傷みは見当たりません。私の好みと違うだけです。不具合があったという理由に変えてお願いするつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 傷みは見ず好み違いを不具合とすり替えないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't noticed any spoilage. It's just not to my taste. I don't intend to change the reason and claim a fault when asking for help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you saw no spoilage and will not misrepresent a difference in taste as a fault. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 開封済みのお好みの問題では、交換できない場合があります。購入記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: An opened item that is simply not to your taste may not be exchangeable. Do you have proof of purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。交換できると決めて持参したのでなく、開封済みと伝えたうえで対応の条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記録あり交換確約と思わず開封状態で条件を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I haven't brought it assuming an exchange is guaranteed; I want to explain that it has been opened and ask about the conditions for assistance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have proof, do not assume an exchange is guaranteed, and want to ask about the conditions while disclosing that it is opened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回は交換の対象にはなりません。別の商品を選ぶ相談はできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This item does not qualify for an exchange. We can help you choose a different product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。この開封品を売場へ戻さず持ち帰ります。次に選ぶ時、同じ味を避けるため表示のどこを見ればいいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象外と理解し売場へ戻さず持帰り次選択の味表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll take this opened item home rather than putting it back on the shelf. For my next purchase, I'd like to know where on the label to look to avoid the same flavor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that it is not eligible, say you will take it home rather than return it to the shelf, and ask about flavor information for next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 味付けの説明がこちらにあります。購入前にご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The seasoning description is here. Please read it before purchasing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今回は自分の好みの違いとして受け止め、次回は説明を確認してから買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 好み違いと受止め次は味説明を購入前に見ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll accept that this was a matter of my personal taste, and check the description before buying next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you accept it was a preference issue and will read the flavor description before your next purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。またお困りの点があればお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-07210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know if you have any other questions.
